## Section: rich_text
```yml
heading: What you will learn
body: |
  - Overview of diabetes pharmacotherapy
  - Comparison of major antidiabetic drug classes
  - Understanding efficacy versus safety when selecting therapy
  - Hypoglycemia risk associated with different drug classes
  - Weight effects of antidiabetic medications
  - Renal considerations in diabetes pharmacotherapy
  - Cardiovascular benefits of selected antidiabetic therapies
  - Drug selection according to individual patient profile
  - Principles of combination therapy
  - Application of pharmacotherapy concepts through interactive clinical cases

  Session Highlights
  - Comprehensive overview of diabetes pharmacotherapy
  - Comparison of major drug classes
  - Efficacy versus safety considerations
  - Hypoglycemia risk assessment
  - Weight-related considerations in drug selection
  - Renal considerations in diabetes management
  - Cardiovascular benefits of selected therapies
  - Patient-profile based drug selection
  - Combination therapy
  - Interactive clinical case discussions
  - Interactive Live Q&A

  Why You Should Join
  Diabetes management is not a one-size-fits-all approach. Choosing the right medication requires consideration of the patient's individual profile, treatment goals, safety concerns, hypoglycemia risk, weight, renal function, and cardiovascular considerations.

  This webinar is designed to help students and healthcare learners understand how different antidiabetic drug classes compare and how treatment choices can be tailored according to the needs of individual patients.

  Through interactive clinical cases, participants will have the opportunity to apply pharmacotherapy concepts to practical patient scenarios and understand the clinical reasoning behind drug selection.

  Target Audience
  - Pharmacy Students
  - Medical Students
  - Healthcare Professionals
  - Residents and Trainees
  - Students interested in Clinical Pharmacotherapy
  - Learners interested in Diabetes Management
  - Philippines students
```
